purpose: Describe protocol-native evidence boundaries and derive implementation-neutral negative conformance oracles.

evidence_surface.observation: HTTPRoute parent status reports Accepted=True for the current observedGeneration
implementation reports a current Programmed condition for the route/parent
request traffic resolves to the route's backend

given: two conflict-equivalent HTTPRoutes share one listener
protocol precedence yields one deterministic winner
dataplane probe reaches only the winner
must_observe: losing route exposes a machine-detectable non-success state for that parent
must_reject: winner and loser remain indistinguishable as successful after status convergence
negative_oracles.protocol_decision_left_open: The oracle does not prescribe whether the losing state is Accepted=False, Programmed=False, or another standardized conflict condition.
negative_oracles.blocking_decision: Gateway API must standardize which Route status condition/reason distinguishes the deterministic loser before a normative conformance test can assert that vocabulary.
negative_oracles.ready_invariant: The deterministic loser must not remain indistinguishable from the winner as successfully effective for the same parent after status convergence and dataplane verification.

implementation_evidence.observation: A current kgateway release moves Route conflicts, dropped routes, and replaced routes to kgateway.dev/Programmed while keeping Accepted scoped to semantic validity.
implementation_evidence.supports_candidate: Accepted remains semantic-validity evidence while Programmed carries dataplane/programming outcome.
implementation_evidence.does_not_establish: Gateway API normative consensus for HTTPRoute conflict status.

given: protocol status reports the affected listener as Accepted=False
protocol status reports the affected listener as Programmed=False
must_observe: dataplane probe confirms the rejected listener is not actually serving traffic
must_reject: status-only conformance success when the dataplane still serves traffic for the rejected listener
negative_oracles.reason: A controller-reported rejection/programming state is not sufficient evidence of dataplane effect when the implementation can still program and serve the rejected configuration.

implementation_evidence.observation: Cilium issue #46917 reports ProtocolConflict listeners marked Accepted=False and Programmed=False while Envoy is still programmed and serves traffic on the conflicted port.
implementation_evidence.supports_candidate: Conformance checks for externally effective routing/listener behavior may require status plus dataplane observation rather than status alone.
implementation_evidence.does_not_establish: That every Gateway API status condition requires a dataplane probe, or that the reported Cilium behavior is normative.

adoption_target.rationale: The project explicitly tests real Gateway API behavior beyond official conformance and has already triggered implementation follow-up work; this oracle matches its existing status-plus-traffic testing model.
proposed_contract: create a deterministic listener protocol conflict
probe rejected listener paths at the dataplane
fail if a rejected listener remains externally effective

must_observe: dataplane probe confirms a newly programmed listener actually accepts traffic
must_reject: status-only success when the dataplane rejected the listener configuration or the listener remains unreachable
negative_oracles.reason: Controller-reported Programmed=True is not sufficient evidence of dataplane effect when Envoy can NACK the generated listener.

implementation_evidence.observation: kgateway issue #14453 reports Accepted=True and Programmed=True while Envoy NACKs a fresh listener and the port remains unreachable; an existing listener can continue serving last-known-good configuration.
implementation_evidence.supports_candidate: Externally effective programming claims should be checked against dataplane observation when downstream xDS rejection can diverge from Kubernetes status.
implementation_evidence.does_not_establish: That every Programmed=True condition requires an end-to-end traffic probe, or that kgateway's extension validation semantics are Gateway API normative behavior.

adoption_target.rationale: The benchmark already measures route readiness with live traffic and documents status/dataplane divergence across implementations.
proposed_contract: create a listener/configuration expected to be reported programmed
wait for current-generation Accepted=True and Programmed=True
probe the listener at the dataplane
fail if the listener remains unreachable or only stale last-known-good behavior is effective

applicability.report_visibility_requirement: The generated probe must belong to a declared conformance profile/feature so its result is not invisible to reports.
